direction: Functional rural community. Services are destinations; homes are scenery. No tall grass in Hearth Town.
notes: Original returned PNG dimensions and alpha preserved without raster post-processing.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Hearth Town functional country-town exploration background for a custom Pokémon region. Revision 2.
Primary request: a beautiful ORIGINAL lived-in rural town ecosystem in crisp, richly readable pixel art, wide 1536x1024 landscape, flat top-down / high RPG camera, north at top. Inspired by the warm everyday LIFE of towns in the Pokémon anime: diverse homes, bakeries, village shops, public services, gardens, local character. This is a country town, not the tiny four-building game starter-town formula. Keep it welcoming, modest and rural. No text or interface.
Architecture: approximately FIFTEEN buildings total with distinct silhouettes, pitches, roof colors, porches, chimneys and materials. Mix white plaster, honey timber, brick, old stone, clapboard, thatched and tiled roofs; some small two-story homes, some bungalows. Slightly irregular believable street layout, not a repetitive grid. Warm terracotta, ochre, muted blue, teal and sage roofs. Each service building should stand apart and have a clear front entrance reachable by the path network. Strong cozy pixel-art craftsmanship, firm pixel clusters, daylight, generous greenery. No photorealism, no 3D/isometric diorama, no watercolor or smooth painted blur.
SIX clearly identifiable community destinations, arranged with enough space to overlay clickable regions later:
1. Professor's lab near x25%,y24%: a modest pale-walled teal-roofed rural research house with an attached little glass greenhouse and a garden, not a futuristic factory.
2. Village market near x48%,y32%: small honey-wood shop with mustard roof, two distinct striped canvas produce stalls outside, tidy baskets of apples and vegetables. A market stall plaza, not a supermarket.
3. Bakery near x23%,y51%: warm brick-and-cream bakery with a red gabled roof, oven chimney, cream awning, tiny hanging loaf-shaped sign and bread window.
4. Pokémon Center near x70%,y49%: attractive white-and-cream country building with red hipped roof, broad porch and clearly visible red/white Poké Ball emblem, no words.
5. Library near x37%,y75%: slightly taller old-stone and wood village library with muted blue slate gable, welcoming porch, book-shaped hanging sign.
6. Daycare near x72%,y77%: pale yellow farmhouse with a sage roof and its own sizeable fenced garden of SHORT MOWN LAWN with one shade tree and simple play equipment. Friendly and domestic.
At x49%,y54% is a small town square with an old shade tree, low stone well, benches, and little flower beds, path junctions with space for player markers.
Scatter EIGHT or NINE distinct RESIDENTIAL homes along small side lanes around the service core, including northwestern, northeastern, eastern and southwestern outskirts. Private porches, laundry lines, mailboxes, picket fences, tidy vegetable beds and little orchards make them feel lived in. Homes are smaller and individually varied. Preserve service landmarks and door access; no residential front doors merged into service buildings.
Landscape and roads: gently curving pale gravel lanes connect the services, the square and the homes; short side paths to private yards. Rural broadleaf trees at the outskirts, low hedges, short maintained lawns, flower gardens, orchard trees. ONE principal road leaves at the NORTH edge near x68%, leading toward future route maps. All other sides end in quiet village gardens and trees.
CRITICAL: absolutely NO TALL GRASS, no wild encounter patches, no bug fields, no wild meadow tufts, no weeds, no route habitat inside town. Town ground is short cut lawn and cultivated gardens only. Tall grass belongs on separate future route maps. No wild Pokémon or trainers baked into the art; runtime characters will be separate.
Composition is full-bleed opaque terrain, no frame, no transparent border, no map title, no legends, no numbers, no text, no letters, no pins, no grid, no UI overlays, no watermark. Keep ALL six community services fully visible with clear breathing room. A believable miniature rural community the player can explore.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent menu-selection avatar for Hearth Town, a living rural community in a custom Pokémon region.
Input image 1 is the architecture, palette and tone reference for Hearth Town revision 2. Create a NEW compact town avatar, not another map.
Primary request: a single welcoming pixel-art village emblem with a genuinely transparent background. Square canvas. Top-down/high RPG view. Strong simple clustered shapes and a clean compact silhouette that reads at 128–192 display pixels, not a dense screenshot. Daylight, warm countryside charm matching the reference. Crisp pixel edges, no soft painting or 3D render.
Composition: a little patch of short-cut green lawn and branching pale stone paths supports FIVE varied miniature buildings as a close-knit village group. Front-left a warm brick bakery with red roof, oven chimney and a small bread awning. Front-right a yellow timber market with striped produce awning. In the back a taller stone library with blue slate roof, a cream Pokémon Center with red roof and tiny red-white ball emblem, and a small yellow sage-roofed daycare house. A single broadleaf tree and small stone well unite the middle. Tiny flowers and low white fencing suggest the cultivated country gardens. Roof silhouettes clearly differ. The whole silhouette feels like a community, not one house.
CRITICAL: NO tall grass, NO wild encounter patches, NO wild Pokémon, no grassland creatures. Hearth Town is a safe inhabited settlement. Gardens are tidy and ground grass is mown short. No text, words, letters, numbers, UI panels, compass, pins, frame, badge outline, watermark or fake checkerboard. No island rock slab and no cast shadow outside the artwork.
Keep the complete village patch inside the central 80% of canvas with transparent padding. Everything outside the organic grassy/tree/building silhouette must be true zero-alpha transparency.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Hearth Town region-map terrain section for composing a larger custom Pokémon world, revision 2.
Input image 1 is the GEOGRAPHY, ARCHITECTURE and STYLE reference for the close-up exploration map. Generate a NEW aerial world-map overview zoomed farther out, preserving the town's personality and landmarks.
Primary request: square full-bleed original pixel-art terrain section, 1024x1024 requested, north up, orthographic top-down RPG world-map perspective, much wider countryside scale. A compact but fully inhabited country town of fourteen varied small buildings sits in the middle/lower portion, occupying about 50% of tile width. Buildings are deliberately small compared to the broadleaf forest and gentle countryside around them. Warm lush early-Pokémon anime countryside rendered as refined crisp pixel art.
Match these landmark positions within the town: teal-roofed lab/greenhouse NW, ochre-roof village market with striped stalls N-center, red-gabled bakery W-center, red-roof Pokémon Center E-center with a tiny ball emblem, stone blue-roof library SW, pale yellow sage-roof daycare with fenced MOWN LAWN and tiny play equipment SE. Center is a mature oak, small stone well and looping sandy village paths. Eight smaller homes are individually varied, with terracotta, blue slate and straw roofs, little gardens, and back yards; a living country community.
The reference's small river skirts the west and south of the town, with a little south footbridge, tree-covered banks, one quiet dock, and a tiny waterfall/pond toward the northwest. Keep water a minor landscape feature, not an ocean/coast. Path from the south footbridge is a short local garden walk ending in trees within the tile, not a second outbound route.
One principal country road leads north from the town's NE side, around x67% of canvas, and reaches the top edge at x67%, connecting to a future route-map section. Dense rounded trees grow in irregular clumps at the outer west/east/south margins, with open short-grass countryside elsewhere. Broad lawns, cultivated gardens, flowerbeds and orchard trees only. No rectangular tree frame.
CRITICAL: NO TALL GRASS anywhere in this asset, NO encounter patches, NO wild Pokémon habitats, NO large grass tufts. Routes with tall grass will be authored separately. This entire first town section is a safe inhabited community.
Full-bleed opaque rectangular ground, no transparent margins, no island, no floating slab, no white background, no frame, no UI, no markers, no labels, no text or lettering, no grid, no legend, no watermark. No cities, towers or modern factories. Carefully readable village silhouette, green country atmosphere, the exact rural service-town identity of the reference at world-map scale.
